name: Flora-Bama
address: 17401 Perdido Key Dr, Pensacola, FL 32507, USA

reviews.author: Diva in the Woods
reviews.text:
Excellent tourist attraction for visitors from other countries who want to experience southern life (or people from other regions of the US who are curious)! I'm from GA and felt right at home.

My visit was Feb. 23, 2026 on a Monday afternoon around 3pm. The gift shop is at the entrance and busier than I expected for the day and time.

We made our way toward the back and this place is MUCH larger that it appears from the street. And my, oh my! So many stairs and so many levels! I'm not sure if

reviews.author: Shannon Smith
reviews.text: My girlfriends and I visited Florabama a few weeks ago and had an amazing time!!! We had great drinks and food, but the service was impeccable!! 5 ⭐️!  We had the best experience with Stacy! She is the best bartender and conversationalist we’ve ever had the pleasure of meeting! We can’t wait to go back! Hands down the best time we’ve ever had! Thanks Stacy for making our trip so memorable!

reviews.author: Cari Breckenridge
reviews.text: Amazing atmosphere! Awesome variety of stuff in their gift shop! Was able to not only eat at the yacht club but also attend their Christmas Day potluck! So amazing what all they do for the community! Really good food and great staff! Great location!

reviews.author: Jackie Van Matre
reviews.text: We just celebrated our sister’s 90th b’day at Florabama.  Florabama is this group of 6 sisters favorite “honky Tonk.”  Your awesome staff is incredibly nice from the time you come in the front door until you leave.  We want to give a special shout out to “Stephanie” in the Main Event Room.  She took such great care of us for 3 nights in a row making sure we found a place to sit and Serving us your famous Bushwackers!  We feel like one big family when we are there celebrating with your staff, mus

reviews.author: R Farmland
reviews.text: There is so much going on here. Two different bands in two separate bar areas. They start early and it goes on into the night. Sometimes they have famous singer/songwriters performing. We come here every year while on vacation.

name: The Hangout
address: 101 E Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, USA

reviews.author: Deidre Knapp
reviews.text: What a cool place!  It uses unique items as part of their decor!  The way burger, fries & Gouda grits & sweet tea  were excellent.  My server, Shay was friendly, professional and attentive.  She recommended a signature sauce to use for my fries.  Delish!  I sat on their deck and was able to enjoy a little more of the beach from a different perspective!

reviews.author: R A
reviews.text: My family and I ate here on a Friday evening, around 7 PM, November 28, 2025. They were not very busy. We were seated pretty quickly. Our server Ava was fairly quick to show up and take our order. We got our drinks quickly. After that, we didn't see her again until someone else delivered our food to us. She asked us how things looked, and kept on walking. I ordered the Redfish, my daughter ordered a double order of crab legs, and my wife got a hamburger (Boring!). We also had the BBQ Nachos, whi

reviews.author: Madison Neal
reviews.text: Visited Hangout in the “off season” and had a great experience. Food came out quickly and was fabulous. I recommend the redfish and shrimp and grits. Our waitress Mauve was excellent. Restaurant was clean with a good atmosphere on the front patio.

reviews.author: Kimeisha C.
reviews.text:
I had such a great experience at The Hangout on the Beach in Gulf Shores! Our waiter, TJ, was absolutely amazing—friendly, kind, funny, and very informative. His menu suggestions were spot on, and he made the whole experience even better. I truly wish him and his fiancée nothing but the best in their future endeavors.

The overall vibe of the restaurant was awesome—fun, energetic, and welcoming. I loved seeing the staff and birthday guests dancing on the tables, which made the atmosphere feel li

reviews.author: Ashley Lawson
reviews.text: First time going to the Hangout to have dinner yesterday evening and it was phenomenal! Ricky made our experience absolutely fantastic! Extremely tentative and kept us laughing the whole time just making sure we had everything we needed as well a great time! 100/10 rating! Will certainly go back every year we come to Orange Beach. Our kids loved being here and it was such a great experience.

name: Subway
address: 25755 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561, USA

reviews.author: STLA_1020
reviews.text: Typical subway experience. Nothing great, nothing bad. Cheap sandwiches that are quick. The workers didn’t seem to be happy to be working but made the sandwiches as asked. If you need a quick lunch and not spend over $20 you can count on Subway.

reviews.author: Tabitha McLaughlin
reviews.text: The restaurant is right across from our hotel.  The staff was friendly and the business was very clean.  We ate there several times during our vacation.  The food was very good.   I highly recommend this business and we will definitely be returning on our next vacation.
